stills.prompt: The same scene, framing and light as @shot: two bare hands with warm brown skin, no face, grip an unfinished raw grey cast-iron five-spoke flywheel casting resting on the worn stone bench. The original engine from @engine stands just behind, its flywheel in frame. Low-key interior: near-black stone workshop with almost no ambient light. One cool bone-white (#F5F2EB) light rakes from high left; everything else falls into black. Photorealistic, natural film grain.
